assets.name: illustration-chef-taste-v2.png
assets.prompt:
Use case: identity-preserve
Asset type: Transparent PNG bust character animation asset for the children's cooking app あきらくんと おりょうり.
Input images: Image 1 is the EDIT TARGET existing approved chef character, already isolated. Image 2 is STYLE and IDENTITY reference approved screen 02, do not reproduce any UI.
Primary request: Edit only the mouth and arms/hands of the boy in Image 1 to add a quiet 'mogu mogu' chewing pose: both hands hold a small triangular rice ball near his mouth, mouth gently closed in a pleased chewing smile. Remove the wooden spoon. This is the SAME boy, not a redesigned character.
Invariants: Preserve the exact head shape, narrow eye shape and proportions, eyebrows, nose, ears, skin tone, black straight fringe and hair texture, hat shape, white chef shirt, yellow apron and green leaf mark. Preserve the original medium and painterly-flat picture book rendering. Do not enlarge or round the eyes; do not change the age. Keep the head at the same angle.
Composition: Complete bust with full hat and both hands, similar proportions and framing to Image 1. One character only, centered, at least 1024px height, generous tiny transparent margin, no clipping.
Backdrop: actual fully transparent alpha background; preserve transparency.
Avoid: text, symbols, UI, panels, background scenery, ground shadows, checkerboard painted into image, new face, extra fingers, photographs, 3D rendering.
assets.inspection: Same narrow eyes, black fringe, hat and leaf apron retained; only mouth/arms/rice change. Genuine RGBA checked; asset accepted.
